versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Content Style Guide skill.
- Produces a practical, example-driven content style guide covering voice, tone by context, mechanics, terminology, and inclusivity/accessibility.
- Includes clear input requirements, output structure, quality checks, and anti-patterns to ensure usable, consistent guidance for teams.
- Supports guides for any content surface (UI, docs, marketing, support) by inferring or confirming brand, audience, and terminology.
